title: Paloma Rewards Referral Bonus Schedule
content:
A Paloma Rewards referral pays two bonuses: one to the referring member and one to the referred new customer, once the new customer's first personal transfer of at least the minimum principal is delivered.

| Tier | Points to the referring member | Points to the referred new customer | Most referral bonuses in the trailing 12 months | Smallest principal of the referred customer's first transfer (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 250 | 250 | 5 | 100.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 250 | 250 | 5 | 100.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 300 | 250 | 10 | 100.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 350 | 250 | 10 | 100.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 400 | 250 | 20 | 100.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 500 | 250 | 20 | 100.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- The referred new customer's bonus is 250 points on every tier; the referring member's bonus rises from 250 points on Paloma Rewards Blue to 500 points on Paloma Rewards Elite.
- The referral limit counts the referral bonuses a referring member receives in the trailing 12 months: 5 on Blue and Silver, 10 on Gold and Platinum, 20 on Diamond and Elite.
- The first-transfer minimum is 100.00 USD on every tier: a first transfer of exactly 100.00 USD meets it, one of 99.99 USD does not.
